questions: Who decides that Barbara C6 should trigger after an eligible death?
Where is the 15-minute cooldown represented and who authoritatively validates it?
Which exact 7.1 AbilityInvokeEntry reports the revive action and how is the authoritative alive state committed?

claims.statement: Current 7.1 resource data shows Barbara C6 installing an off-stage DoReviveMixin chain that starts hidden skill 10076 and executes ReviveAvatar for AllPlayerAvatars with HealHP = 1.0.

evidence.note: Barbara_Constellation_6 installs the ReBorn ability family.
ReBorn_Pre uses OffStage DoReviveMixin; kill-side actions start skill 10076; ReBorn runs AvatarSkillStart(10076) and ReviveAvatar.

claims.statement: Current 7.1 AvatarSkill data identifies skill 10076 as Avatar_Barbara_ReBorn with cdTime = 900 seconds, making it the concrete cooldown identity used by the C6 resource chain.

evidence.note: The C6 execution chain starts skill 10076 with AvatarSkillStart.

claims.statement: The current 7.1 Ability invocation channel used by AstaPS is AbilityInvocationsNotify / CmdId 6622, and the local 7.1 registry binds CmdId 6622 to obfuscated type ALPCFFANJPJ.

evidence.note: The current AstaPS receive path parses AbilityInvocationsNotify entries and dispatches them through AbilityManager.

claims.notes: The exact Barbara C6 AbilityInvokeEntry carried on this channel is still unresolved, so this is not yet a canonical semantic opcode promotion.

claims.statement: The exact AbilityInvokeEntry emitted when Barbara C6 fires, including local_id, argument_type and ability_data, has not yet been recovered.
It is not yet known how the official server validates, stores or restores the cooldown state for hidden skill 10076.
The exact official 7.1 path that commits the revived avatar from dead to authoritative alive state remains unresolved.

rejected_paths.statement: Treat a Barbara-specific wall-clock timer in generic server death handling as the native C6 trigger model.
rejected_paths.reason: Current 7.1 resources contain a dedicated off-stage Ability trigger chain and hidden skill 10076; the server timer is at most an integration fallback/anti-replay mechanism.

rejected_paths.statement: Use generic/historical ReviveDeadAvatar naming as the concrete Barbara C6 action name in 7.1.
rejected_paths.reason: The current Barbara resource chain uses ReviveAvatar.

next_steps: Capture otherwise identical lethal events with Barbara C6 ready, Barbara C6 cooling down, and Barbara/C6 unavailable.
Decode every CmdId 6622 AbilityInvokeEntry around those events and identify the sequence unique to the ready-C6 case.
Resolve the captured local_id through the instanced ability/action tables and bind it to Avatar_Barbara_ReBorn / ReviveAvatar.
After the exact wire path is proven, evaluate removal of the Barbara-specific trigger fallback while retaining authoritative revive-state synchronization and cooldown validation.
